whatsapp.intro: Message your Chief of Staff from WhatsApp using a number you link to Murage. Keep Murage running to receive messages. Approvals stay in Murage.
whatsapp.risk.title: Link your own WhatsApp number
whatsapp.risk.how: Murage links to WhatsApp the way WhatsApp Web does, from this computer, using your own number. Your bot can then reply to you, and to the contacts you choose, inside WhatsApp.
whatsapp.risk.unofficial: WhatsApp does not offer this link officially. WhatsApp may restrict or remove a number it sees driven by other software, without notice. A spare number on a second SIM or eSIM, set up in the WhatsApp Business app, is the best way to use this. Linking your main number is possible, but it is your number to risk.
whatsapp.risk.local: The WhatsApp session and its linking credentials stay on this computer. Messages and audio use the model and transcription services you configure. Replies go only to chats that message first; there is no broadcasting.
whatsapp.risk.official: Linking your own number is the way to connect today. WhatsApp's official business route is a later option and is not available yet.

In a group set to Every message, it answers every message. Everyone in a group, including you, is a guest there: the bot uses only that group's conversation, never personal memory, and never approves anything.
